text:
maria.g: Heads-up — we have a batch where customer credits were applied to the wrong tenant and one invoice draft got duplicated. Noticed after reconciliation run, invoice ID INV-2026-0422A missing GPU line.

sam.t: ugh. do we know why credits landed on wrong tenant? fuzzy email match?

atul.p: looks like our fuzzy matcher treated 'acme-support@' and 'accounts-acme@' as same org. credits keyed to org_id X instead of tenant Y.

billing-bot: Reconciliation job completed: batch_id=rb-20260422-9, processed=1204, anomalies=3 (credit_misalloc, duplicate_draft, trimmed_lines).

kevin.r: can you paste the invoice snippet? I want to see the missing line amounts.

maria.g: here are the relevant lines from the draft (redacted):
```
INV-2026-0422A: customer_acme_tenantY
- compute_gpu_hours: 128.00 -> $12,800.00
- inference_requests: 1,234,567 -> $3,456.78
- reserved_capacity_credit: -$2,000.00  <-- MISSING from this draft
```
INV-2026-0422B: customer_acme_orgX (duplicate draft)
- reserved_capacity_credit: -$2,000.00  <-- wrongly applied here
```

sam.t: so the credit exists but is on the wrong invoice. That explains the missing line. why did reconciler trim GPU line?

atul.p: trimming happened because when credit applied total went negative for one invoice and our 'suppress_small_lines' filter removed lines under $5. rounding interaction pushed GPU net to 0.00 in the draft generation path.

sara_ops: who needs to sign off on manual reissue & credit note? this will affect April revenue recognition.

maria.g: finance + revops. cc @sara_ops, @kevin.r. propose this action: 1) reassign credit to tenantY in billing DB, 2) regenerate both drafts, 3) create one consolidated invoice INV-2026-0422 with a manual credit note applied to preserve audit trail, 4) run a targeted regen for affected customers.

kevin.r: ok, sounds right. I need SQL to find similar misallocations before we rerun. atul, can you give the query?

atul.p: using match_log table. query (example):
```
-- finds fuzzy matches that were accepted in last 30d
SELECT ml.match_id, ml.left_id, ml.right_id, ml.score, c1.org, c2.org
FROM match_log ml
JOIN customers c1 ON c1.id = ml.left_id
JOIN customers c2 ON c2.id = ml.right_id
WHERE ml.rule = 'email_alias_fuzzy' AND ml.score >= 0.82 AND ml.created_at >= now() - interval '30 days';
```

sam.t: also add a check for credits posted in the same batch to different tenant ids:
```
SELECT credit_id, posted_to_tenant, original_owner_tenant
FROM credit_postings
WHERE batch_id = 'rb-20260422-9' AND posted_to_tenant <> original_owner_tenant;
```

billing-bot: Action logged: tas-4829 created (label: credit-misalloc). Assigned to @atul.p.

maria.g: immediate mitigation: atul, plz pause fuzzy-match auto-accept for billing-related rules. we will do a backfill script instead of auto-correct.

atul.p: pausing now. will also run detection query across last 60 days and create a CSV for finance review. ETA 3h.

kevin.r: finance: once we have the CSV i'll validate, then approve manual credit move + one consolidated invoice. also need to notify the customer (acme) — message should explain duplicate draft and that final invoice will replace drafts.

sara_ops: please include a line for 'manual credit adjustment' in the audit note. we need the audit trail for SOX.

maria.g: noted. i'll draft the customer note and the internal memo for revops. thanks all.

atul.p: update: detection script finished, found 6 similar cases across last 45 days. uploading CSV to /shared/finance/credit-misalloc-20260422.csv

sam.t: great catch. after fix can we add an alert in console when reserved_credit_posting and invoice_tenant mismatch > 0?

maria.g: yes, add to Optimize roadmap. open ticket for console alerting.

billing-bot: Comment added to tas-4829: "found 6 historical misallocs; paused fuzzy auto-accept; manual reassign planned"

kevin.r: ACK. i'll coordinate signoff later today and confirm reissue schedule.

sara_ops: thanks everyone.

maria.g: closing thread for now — will reopen if anything else pops up.
